scope: strategy persistence fix, anonymized request-context audit, read-only full-match audit and real pre-native refusal

strategy_fix.problem: A refreshed plan retaining an in-flight request did not pre-reserve it; a higher-priority new task could claim its same formation first.
strategy_fix.result: All in-flight roster/resource/budget reservations are counted before sorting requests, and repeated held tasks are not charged twice.
strategy_fix.real_control_limit: Trusted executor reservations already prevented actual duplicate allocation; this fixes the planning contract.

request_context_metadata.fields_scope: opaque task/mission/target IDs, phase/deadline/revision, compaction/context counts, snapshot/game clock, payload hash/bytes
request_context_metadata.not_a_claim_of_actual_paid_model_call: A context attempt can still end in timeout/transport failure; correlate plans and transport records.
request_context_metadata.accepted_plan_correlation: unique exact (snapshot_id,game_time_seconds) context -> request_id -> accepted plan, on same post-TTL compacted record

new_cases: retained task repeated plus higher-priority formation or force conflict
same mission in two actual local adapter contexts after 50 progress updates and deterministic compaction
missing mission from actual request rejected
no context evidence on historical run remains unproved
post-TTL failed request cannot borrow a pre-TTL accepted plan to establish full acceptance
duplicate request/context snapshot+clock key is ambiguous and cannot prove an accepted context

limits: Only prints audit JSON; no game/mapping/network connections.
Synthetic classes/fixtures prove guards, not gameplay effects.
A qualified damage amount does not establish economic suppression or victory causation.
Current legacy semantic route remains unused by Host/client and does not auto-enable V5/V6.
